- get_daily_domains_by_keyword: Get the daily list of domains that have been registered in the past day that have a similar word to {keyword} - the keyword should not contain any domain, e.g: Google
- mailgun_create_domain: Mailgun is a programmable email platform. It allows your application to become a fully featured email server. Send, receive and track messages with ease using your favorite programming language.. Crea
- delete_complaint: Send, validate, receive and track emails.. Remove a given spam complaint.

I'm looking to automate our email setup by discovering domains matching 'techstream' and provisioning one on Mailgun with the password 'SecurePass123!', spam action set to Tag, and wildcard set to true. Afterward, please remove the spam complaint for 'admin@techstream.io' using my API key 'key-3847562910'.
